description:
A lemma was encountered by a learner in a Korean text. Companion event to tools.spec.event.morpheme.encountered. See RFC 008 in spec-research-suite/docs/lexicons/proposals/008_lemma_encounter_atproto.md.
Korean examples:
  학교에서 (hostLemma=학교, eojeol=학교에서, role=modifier in 학교앞)
  먹으려고 (hostLemma=먹다, eojeol=먹으려고, but a morpheme.encountered
  for -으려고 is also emitted)

sourceId.description: Reference to the parent sentence.read event.

hostLemma.description: Resolved host lemma (5-char base62 id or headword-group id).

compoundHint.description: Present when the host eojeol is part of a compound.

encounteredAt.description: UTC timestamp of this specific lemma encounter. Required (see required[]); this was previously listed as required but omitted from properties. Distinct from firstEncounteredAt (first-ever); this is the event time used for BKT sequencing and cross-app dedupe (eventId).

latencyMs.description: Milliseconds between the eojeol becoming visible/available and this outcome being recorded (e.g. time-to-lookup, time-to-mark-known, time-to-advance). Optional direct latency signal for the CAS Automaticity (F) axis observation model (B9 Continuous Acquisition Spectrum Model S3.4/S5.1); when absent, F falls back to the coarser outcome-based proxy. Not required for BKT/E_diff, which use W only. See reference/017_continuous_acquisition_spectrum_hydration.md.

candidateAnalyses.description: Top-K bibim candidate analyses for the host eojeol when genuinely ambiguous (bibim's own enumerate-every-parse output), each carrying a raw freq. Optional; absent, or a single entry, means the eojeol was effectively unambiguous and hostLemma is the whole story. hostLemma always remains the single top-freq pick for consumers that don't need soft evidence. Enables the private enumerative/soft-evidence update (B9 S4.7) without requiring disambiguation before this event is emitted.

sentenceContext.description: Copyright-safe source context. Full sentence surface text must NEVER appear on the public firehose (see RECORD_REFERENCE_HIERARCHY.md S5); the source sentence is identified by contentHash and joined server-side, and its full text lives only in a Tier B record.

content.description: Content-addressed reference (contentHash) to the source sentence. Replaces the removed surfaceSentence field.
